c74object.name: naka.artnet
c74object.digest: Send DMX over Art-Net or sACN
c74object.description: naka.artnet sends one DMX universe over the network as Art-Net 4 or sACN (ANSI E1.31), for example to an ENTTEC ODE or another Ethernet-DMX node. It takes the same value messages as naka.dmxusbpro, so a patch can switch between USB and network output by changing the object name.

method.name: list
method.description: Channel 1-512, value 0-255. Channel 0 sets every channel. The first value starts sending unless stop was sent.

method.name: ch
method.digest: Set consecutive channels from a start channel

method.name: stop
method.description: Values are kept and new values don't restart sending until start. With sACN, receivers are told the stream ended. Receivers that lock onto one sender release it after their timeout.

method.name: poll
method.description: Sends ArtPoll to the broadcast address (or the given address). Each reply comes out of the left outlet as node <ip> <short name> <long name> followed by the port-addresses of its outputs.

attribute.name: universe
attribute.digest: Art-Net port-address 0-32767 (Net * 256 + Sub-Net * 16 + Universe), or sACN universe 1-63999

attribute.name: host
attribute.digest: Destination IP address; empty = broadcast (Art-Net) or multicast (sACN)

attribute.name: bind
attribute.digest: Local IP address to send from; empty = any interface

attribute.name: keepalive
attribute.digest: Repeat an unchanged frame every this many ms (0 = off, default 1000)
